qualitative.gate_2_reason: Substantial earnings and capital concentration in Russia and non-Western CEE jurisdictions, with trapped capital under Russian capital controls, regulatory de-risking demands from the ECB, and acute US OFAC sanctions tail risk.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (pariah jurisdiction & geopolitical ruin risk, REJECT). Raiffeisen Bank International derived a major share of consolidated earnings from its Russian subsidiary, where billions in capital remain trapped under Russian restrictions. The bank faces immense regulatory de-risking pressure from the ECB and severe sanctions scrutiny from the US Treasury / OFAC.
qualitative.evidence: Austrian banking group with extensive operations across Central and Eastern Europe. Russia historically contributed over 40-50% of group net profit. Following the Ukraine invasion, Russian earnings and equity cannot be repatriated. Under formal ECB pressure to accelerate Russian balance sheet wind-down and under US OFAC sanctions investigation, creating unacceptable existential geopolitical and regulatory tail risk.
